intent_to_execution_compiler.purpose: Compile confirmed customer intent into bounded executable work packages and acceptance tests.

exception_autopilot.purpose: Classify eligible failures, select bounded recovery playbooks, retest, and escalate only when limits are exceeded.

evidence_driven_completion_gate.purpose: Prevent BUILD_COMPLETE, QA_PASS or DELIVERED claims without required evidence.

customer_dependency_automation.purpose: Detect missing customer inputs, produce clear requests/reminders, and maintain CLIENT_ACTION_REQUIRED state without consuming hidden delivery time.

sla_deadline_guardian.purpose: Detect schedule risk early and route reprioritisation or human rebaseline before a commitment is missed.

autonomous_tool_model_router.purpose: Select an eligible execution path using support, quality, reliability, latency and cost evidence.

learning_optimization_loop.purpose: Convert verified project outcomes into candidate improvements for discovery, pricing, capability and capacity policies.

commercial_recovery_engine.purpose: Handle failed payment, expiring quotation and customer inactivity with policy-bounded follow-up actions.

autonomous_change_impact_analyzer.purpose: Prepare scope, cost, time, dependency, risk and regression impact evidence before the existing Change Request workflow.

global_kill_switch_circuit_breaker.purpose: Stop affected autonomous action classes on security, cost, loop, systemic-failure or stale-evidence signals.

invariants: No inferred customer requirement becomes confirmed without customer confirmation or approved scope evidence
No autonomous recovery may cross a Production or irreversible customer-impact boundary
Completion status requires evidence and must not rely on agent self-assertion
Customer dependency follow-up must respect communication consent and approved channels
Deadline automation may reprioritise within policy but may not invent or extend contractual commitments
Tool and model routing may only choose supported eligible execution paths
Learning output is advisory candidate evidence and cannot silently rewrite commercial or safety policy
Commercial recovery may not charge, renew, extend a contract, or issue compensation automatically
Change impact analysis never substitutes for customer and human commercial approval where required
Circuit breakers fail closed and require explicit governed recovery before affected action classes resume
